items.text: Carolina (early week): IR - CB Jaycee Horn (quad), CB Mike Jackson (groin), OT Taylor Moton, CB Akayleb Evans, RB Jonathon Brooks; PUP - OT Ikem Ekwonu. Questionable - LB Jaelan Phillips (hamstring), LB Bobby Okereke (foot), G Damien Lewis (knee), CB Will Lee III (hamstring), all inactive Wk9. WR Xavier Legette to be designated to return. Bryce Young expected to start.

New Orleans (early week): C Erik McCoy (biceps) to miss time, week-to-week. IR - RB Travis Etienne Jr. Questionable - RB CJ Donaldson (shoulder/concussion). DT Davon Godchaux traded to JAX. Tyler Shough expected to start.
items.source: ESPN (Saints C Erik McCoy to miss time, Nov 9)
